question:
Identify the error in tense and choose the correct form of the verb in present tense from the following options.

My teacher often forget the name of students.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Forgets'.**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The erroneous part of the given sentence is: **'Forget'**.
 
• The given sentence is in the** 'Present Indefinite Tense'**.
 
• So, the rule is:* **"Subject + Verb( 1st form) + Object"*****.**
 
• According to the rule, the subject** is in Singular form**.
 
• So, verb must be **'forgets'** to make the sentence correct.
 
 
• **Example**: *Robin forgets the address of the place.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: **'was forgetting'** used in** 'Past continuous Tense**'.
 
• **Option 2**: '**have been forgetting**' used in **'Present Perfect Tense'.**
 
• **Option 3**: **'forgot'** used in **'Past Indefinite Tense'.**
